system.implants: Basic Biomods, Basic Mesh Inserts, Cortical Stack, Echolocation, Enhanced Hearing, Oxygen Reserve
system.advantages: +5 COO, +5 INT, +5 SOM, +5 to one other aptitude of the player's choice, +40 Swimming skill, Ramming Attack (1d10 DV)
system.disadvantages: Neo-belugas lack a sense of smell
system.description:
Neo-belugas are the smallest and most numerous of the surviving whale uplifts, ranging 5.5 meters in length on average. They are white-skinned with no dorsal ridge, toothed, and have the distinction of being the only whale that can swim backwards.

Notes: Large Size trait, Non-Human Biochemistry trait

Source: Eclipse Phase Morph Recognition Guide, p. 60.
